decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed outbuilding would not be harmful to neighbouring residents' living conditions or the appearance of the area.  It is in compliance with adopted policies ENV-B.1, H.6.4, and Residential Extension Guidelines of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding any details shown in the approved plans, the building hereby permitted shall be built from red/brown sandfaced flettons or such other bricks as shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To protect the apperance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.  To protect the amenity and privacy of nearby residents)

Condition : 5 - The approved out building shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the existing dwelling on the site and shall not be used as separate living accommodation or for business purposes.

REASON:  To protect neighbouring residents' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Erection of a detached building at back of rear garden of house, for use as a games room ancillary to the house.
